folders.purpose: Unsorted incoming files — web clips, drops, imports
Converted academic papers as markdown with frontmatter
Research notes, meeting notes, ideas, reading notes
Audio transcriptions from interviews, meetings, lectures
Writing in progress — papers, grant proposals, reports
Presentation prep, slide notes, talk outlines
Recommendation letters, committee work, admin tasks
Plugin metadata — cheat sheet, reflections, friction log
Researcher's own capabilities — custom trackers, callout patterns, workflows. Never touched by plugin updates.

_comment_databases: databases.always is included for ALL researchers. customizations.*.additional_databases are ADDED on top of always — never replace it. Claude reads this config via the SKILL layer, not the CLI.

qualitative.note: For qualitative researchers with fieldwork data

quantitative.note: For quantitative researchers working with datasets

teaching_heavy.note: For researchers with significant teaching load

writing_heavy.note: For researchers actively writing papers, thesis, or dissertation
